root_cause_label: Vision Task Fallback Without Image Analysis
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent assumed the chess position FEN would be embedded in PNG metadata rather than visually interpreting the image, and after exhausting all metadata extraction approaches never pivoted to any vision/OCR strategy, ending without a valid move written to /app/move.txt.
t_err_evidence: look for embedded metadata (e.g., a FEN string) within the PNG ... extract a FEN ... use a chess engine
t_commit_evidence: Step 10: the FEN extraction script conclusively returns 'No FEN found', confirming no metadata-embedded position exists. The agent then continues to pursue FEN-finding and metadata tools for 30 more steps rather than pivoting to image analysis, locking in the failure.
trigger_explanation: At step 1, the agent acts on the unverified false assumption that the chess board image encodes its position as embedded PNG text metadata (FEN string). The task actually requires visually interpreting the board image. This unverified belief is never challenged and drives all subsequent tool installations (exiftool, imagemagick, chafa) and string searches.
forewarning_evidence: strings -n 8 chess_board.png | grep -i -E 'fen|FEN' -> (command executed successfully with no output)
